meta.title: A free mockup of your future website | Cosmic Studio
meta.description: Request a free mockup of your future website: pick a colour mood, describe what you have in mind and receive a first proposal by email. No commitment.

freeMockup.title: See your site before you decide
freeMockup.intro: Tell us where you stand and the mood you have in mind. We send you a mockup of your future website, free of charge and with no commitment.

brief.title: You send the essentials
brief.description: Your email address and, if you like, a colour mood and the address of your current website.

design.title: We prepare the mockup
design.description: A first look at your home page, based on what you told us.

deliver.title: Then you decide
deliver.description: The mockup arrives by email. If it is not for you, that is the end of it, at no cost.

freeMockup.privacy_notice: Your email address and your message are only used to prepare and send your mockup.

form.heading: Request your mockup
form.lead: Only your email address is required.
form.wishes_placeholder: The pages you need, what you like, what you would rather avoid…
form.success_message: Thank you. We will send you your mockup by email.
form.error_message: Your request could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
form.retry_later_message: Your request could not be sent right now. Please try again a little later.
form.plan_attached: The results of your pricing simulation will be included with your request.

validation.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.url_invalid: Please enter a valid website address, for example my-site.com.
validation.wishes_too_long: Please keep your message under 500 characters.
